expectedBehavior: Verify the active Linux SDK archive in isolation and classify the first workload-free HelloIos build failure.
observedBehavior: SDK 10.0.402 SHA-512 matched official metadata and ran from an isolated temporary root. With no workloads installed, the ordinary HelloIos build stopped at NETSDK1147, requesting wasm-tools rather than ios.
limitations: No workload set, iOS manifest, or iOS pack was installed.
The observed wasm-tools request does not establish an iOS resolver strategy.
nextDecision: Compare against a corrected Mac AOT-capable reference, then test the official and project-owned manifest graphs in a disposable home during M1.

commands.command: Download, SHA-512 verify, and extract dotnet-sdk-10.0.402-linux-x64.tar.gz into /tmp/opencode; run dotnet --info with isolated HOME, DOTNET_ROOT, and NUGET_PACKAGES.
DOTNET_ROOT=<isolated-root> dotnet build tests/HelloIos/HelloIos.csproj -f net10.0-ios -r ios-arm64 -c Release --no-restore /bl:<local-binlog>
